entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Delicious food, fluffy sheets...[n]I've graduated from the life[n]of a stray cat.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess home is what you make of it—[n]even this musty old attic, of all places.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, take care of me like this back[n]home too, okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't say this[n]in front of all the[n]others, but...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to see you,[n]privately. Can I come[n]by Leblanc tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, do you think[n]we could meet again[n]tomorrow evening?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If it's all right[n]with you, we have[n]much to talk about...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, let's meet again[n]tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can celebrate your[n]getting released, just[n]the two of us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I have something for[n]you too. I'll see[n]you at your place?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The party's not over.[n]Tomorrow is the real[n]one. After you work.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I have a gift too.[n]Let's meet just the[n]two of us.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've been waiting[n]for you to get home!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I have so much I want[n]to talk to you about.[n]I'd love to see you...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Do you want[n]to hang out[n]tomorrow night?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I hear you're back home? You[n]should let me examine you to[n]make sure you're okay.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Just kidding. I just[n]wanted to see you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can I come over[n]tomorrow after work?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I heard that you[n]returned safely.[n]I'm so glad...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I want to talk to[n]you in person. Can[n]you meet tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I can go to[n]your place,[n]if you'd like.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Exclusive: [f 4 3]'s[n]Tearful Release!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: How's it feel to be free?[n]You better come see me...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Or I'll just go to[n]your place tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I heard that you've[n]returned. Welcome back...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'd like to see you. Do you have[n]plans for tomorrow evening?
What should I do tomorrow?
I can only spend time with[n]one person... What should[n]I do tomorrow?
Spend time with Makoto.
Spend time with Haru.
Spend time with Ann.
Spend time with Futaba.
Spend time with Chihaya.
Spend time with Takemi.
Spend time with Kawakami.
Spend time with Ohya.
Spend time with Hifumi.
Don't respond.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Great.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll stop by when the[n]shop is about to close.[n]Well, good night.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Perfect! I'll see you[n]tomorrow then!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yay! I'll come by[n]tomorrow night.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Nighttt!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Woohoo! I'm gonna[n]charge in tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Like a bull in a[n]coffee shop! Well,[n]seeya!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Really? Okay, if you insist...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I look forward to[n]seeing you tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Glad to hear it.[n]I'm looking forward[n]to tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I think I'll come visit[n]you at night, then.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I look forward to[n]tomorrow, Master.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Really? Okay, then[n]I'll stop by in[n]the evening.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: See you tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, is that all right?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: If you insist... I'll see you[n]tomorrow then. Good night.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You never change, do you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's go to bed. You're[n]working at the shop from tomorrow[n]onward, right?
